output_text:
```python
import os
from google.cloud import texttospeech

def select_google_cloud_voice(project_id: str, locale: str) -> texttospeech.SynthesizeSpeechRequest:
    client = texttospeech.TextToSpeechClient()
    voice = None
    # List available voices to select one
    voices = client.list_voices(project=project_id, language_codes=[locale])
    for voice_info in voices:
        if voice_info.name == f"{locale}-wavenet-f":  # Example: 'en-US-Wavenet-F'
            voice = voice_info
            break
    if not voice:
        raise ValueError(f"No suitable voice found for locale: {locale}")
    return texttospeech.SynthesizeSpeechRequest(
        input=texttospeech.SynthesisInput(text="Hello, this is a test of the Google Cloud Text-to-Speech service!"),
        voice=voice,
        audio_config=texttospeech.AudioConfig(audio_encoding=texttospeech.AudioEncoding.LINEAR16)
    )
```
